title: Programs
overview: This guide covers programs workflows for System Admin.

subtasks.title: Review the Care Program List
subtasks.purpose: See every configured care program, its billing codes and category at a glance.

steps.title: Open Care Programs
steps.description: Click Programs in the left sidebar.

steps.title: Review Summary Cards
steps.description: Review the summary cards to see the total counts of programs, billing codes and categories.

steps.title: Search Care Programs
steps.description: Use the Search care programs… box to filter the list.

steps.title: Sort Program List
steps.description: Sort by any column header (Program Name, Billing Codes, Category).

steps.title: Page Through Programs
steps.description: Use the pager (Page 1 of N) or Show entries dropdown to page through the list.

steps.title: Edit or Delete Program
steps.description: Use the blue edit or red delete icons in the Action column to modify or remove a program. Notes The chip beside the program name (CCM, RPM) identifies the program type and drives which billing codes are available. Deleting a program is blocked while patients are actively enrolled — retire the program via edit → Inactive instead.

subtasks.title: Add a new care program
subtasks.purpose: Register a new care program with billing codes, category and clinical requirements.

steps.title: Add Care Program
steps.description: From the Care Program List, click + Add Program (top-right).

steps.title: Enter Program Identity
steps.description: On the Identity form, enter the Program Name, program-type chip (CCM / RPM), short code and Category.

steps.title: Add Billing Codes
steps.description: On the Billing & Coding form, add each CPT / HCPCS code, its description and any minimum service-time requirement.

steps.title: Define Clinical Requirements
steps.description: On the Clinical Requirements form, define the required device types, measurement-day threshold and any protocol notes.

steps.title: Save or Cancel Program
steps.description: Click Save to create the program, or Cancel to discard. Notes Category groups programs on the summary card and in reports (e.g. Chronic Care, Remote Monitoring). Billing codes entered here become selectable when generating a billing report for a patient enrolled in this program. Clinical Requirements enforce the minimum evidence needed before a billing code becomes eligible.

subtasks.title: Edit or delete a care program
subtasks.purpose: Update program details / billing codes or retire a program that is no longer offered.

steps.title: Locate the Program
steps.description: Locate the program in the list.

steps.title: Open Edit Program Form
steps.description: Click the blue edit icon to open the same Identity / Billing / Clinical forms and update any field.

steps.title: Delete the Program
steps.description: To remove a program, click the red trash icon and confirm the deletion. Notes Changes to billing codes take effect immediately for future billing cycles; already-generated reports are not retroactively modified. Task 6.10 — Settings
